A free, open-source JavaScript library for creating dynamic, data-driven visualizations using a low-level, web-standards-based approach.: Low-level, standards-based rendering (HTML/CSS/SVG) for maximu

I just finished my fourth study pass on d3/d3, and I’m still wrestling with how it deliberately avoids abstracting the DOM into ready-made charts. Instead of handing you polished components, it forces you to bind data directly to SVG, HTML, and CSS elements through selections and joins, which gives incredible control but means building every layout from scratch. After mapping a dozen patterns across two previous repos, I expected a more opinionated framework, but D3’s decade-long dominance proves that granular, standards-based rendering scales better for custom dashboards. I’m still fuzzy on how its modular function chain actually manages internal state, so I’ll keep tracing the source until it clicks.
